title: JSON Forms Extended configuration
description: Form-wide defaults for extended controls, editors, templates, markup and security. Individual elements can override applicable defaults.

allOf.description: Includes common form configuration and shared extension defaults.
Additional defaults for extended controls and presentation elements.

jsonformsExtended.description: Settings for template engines, editor diagnostics, colors, markup and security.

monaco.description: Code-editor defaults for row sizing, automatic growth, editor options and initialization actions. A control's monaco object replaces this default object.

language.description: Default language identifier for code editors, such as json or javascript.

:language.description: Root-data path whose value selects the code-editor language. Takes precedence over a fixed language.

convertJson.description: Parses JSON editor text into a structured value before storing it. Invalid JSON stays as an editable draft and preserves the last committed value.

height.description: Default height for code editors, grids and split layouts, in pixels or a CSS dimension.

width.description: Default code-editor width, in pixels or a CSS dimension.

theme.description: Editor theme name or appearance preference. Takes precedence over mode.

mode.description: Fallback editor appearance preference when theme is not specified.

agGridOptions.description: Default grid options, including column definitions and other grid-specific settings. A control's agGridOptions object replaces this default object.

propagateErrors.description: Publishes code-editor error diagnostics as additional form errors. Legacy flat default; jsonformsExtended.propagateErrors takes precedence.

defaultTemplateLang.description: Default TemplateLayout engine when the element does not specify lang. Legacy flat default; jsonformsExtended.defaultTemplateLang takes precedence.

allowAdditionalPropertiesIfMissing.description: Offers a dynamic-property editor when the data schema omits additionalProperties. This affects editor availability, not schema validation.

allowEmptyPropertyNames.description: Allows creating properties with an empty or whitespace-only name. Names must still satisfy the data schema's propertyNames constraints.

showBorder.description: Shows a border around tuple controls.

showActions.description: Shows confirmation and cancellation actions in duration and cron pickers. When false, picker changes commit immediately.

resizable.description: Allows users to resize panes in split layouts.

extendedOnly.description: Defaults for templates, code-editor diagnostics, color controls, markup and security.

security.description: Permissions for string scripts and policies for URLs used by presentation elements.

defaultTemplateLang.description: Default TemplateLayout engine when the element does not specify lang. Falls back to ractive when no default is configured.

propagateErrors.description: Publishes code-editor error diagnostics as additional form errors. Defaults to false. Disabling publication leaves diagnostics inside the editor and preserves schema and server errors.

colorTextEntry.description: Offers a text input alongside the color picker.

colorSaveFormat.description: Format used to store selected colors: hex, short hex, RGB or HSB.

markup.description: Markdown rendering policy and typography defaults for text elements.

dynamicValues.description: Controls access to form data and context during Label text interpolation.

security.description: Permissions for evaluating string scripts and using URLs in presentation elements.

allowScriptEvaluation.description: Allows evaluating string scripts and executable string templates. Enable only for trusted authored content. Function-valued host code does not need string evaluation.

urlPolicy.description: Allowed URL schemes, relative URLs and image data URLs for links, images and Markdown.
URL rules for links, images and Markdown content.

allowedSchemes.description: Permitted URL schemes, such as https, http and mailto.

allowRelative.description: Allows relative URLs, such as /help or images/logo.png.

allowImageDataUrls.description: Allows data:image URLs for images. Other data URLs remain subject to the scheme policy.

templateLang.description: Template engine. An unknown language is diagnosed, never interpreted as another engine.

markup.description: Markdown and typography defaults for text elements.

enabled.description: Enables Markdown formatting for text elements that request it. When false, the text is still displayed without Markdown formatting.

profile.description: basic supports paragraphs, line breaks, emphasis, inline code, links and lists. extended also supports headings, blockquotes, tables and fenced code. Both exclude raw HTML and images.

markdown.description: Controls whether Markdown is enabled and which formatting features are available.

typography.description: Uses themed typography for rendered text. An element's typography option can override this default.

dynamicValues.description: Permissions for accessing form data and context during Label text interpolation.

enabled.description: Allows Label interpolation expressions to access data, item, config and context. Static text parameters remain usable when false. This does not enable dynamic UI-element overlays.
